findings.issue: V5 selection accepts rejected stage2_v5_simple and stage3_fast while inference_v5 hardcodes motion_collision/compatible.
findings.requested_fix: Require exact final module tuple and reject incompatible selections; exclude failed ROI/simple modules.

findings.issue: Only checks report status, not report package identity or packaged inference/source/input binding. Stale PASS results can be supplied.
findings.requested_fix: Bind actual execution report to resolved package path plus package/entrypoint hash and frozen input manifest; validate selection status/modules before PASS.

findings.issue: Checks only supplied source_sha256 entries; no required coverage. Verifier checks changed paths but not changed file digest against selection SHA.
findings.requested_fix: Require all packaged source/entrypoint/requirements/model bindings; compare selected package path digests directly in final verifier. Preserve entire Stage2 model subtree from actual V3 manifest.

findings.issue: Offline subprocess relies on caller using -I; connect_ex not blocked and no isolated flag recorded. Per-stage solution.__file__ check is present and useful.
findings.requested_fix: Invoke with -I; record/assert isolated interpreter, add connect_ex deny if claiming socket connection blocking.

positive_checks: Selection file absent at review and read occurs before ZIP creation.
Builder code allowlist does not glob all solution modules.
Package verifier checks archive hash/size, exact extracted file set, per-file hash/size, V3 path change scope.
Actual offline verifier asserts imported solution module paths are within extracted package after each stage.
Stage2 original V3 code/model identity already recorded in research/v5_stage2/decision.json.
scope_limit: Final gate cannot be approved until selection manifest, compatible result and corrected guards exist; no new submission or performance claim.
